description: This file defines the 'SlidingTabStrip' class, a custom view extending LinearLayout used for rendering a tab strip with indicators, dividers, and underline for a sliding tab layout component in an Android application.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: Custom view that draws the indicator, dividers, and bottom border for a sliding tab layout, managing drawing based on the selected tab position and color schemes.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface for providing custom indicator and divider colors for each tab position.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: Default implementation of TabColorizer, using arrays of colors for indicators and dividers.

methods.name: SlidingTabStrip
methods.description: Constructor initializing paint objects and configuration based on display metrics and theme attributes.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the selected tab indicator.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset, and redraws the strip.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the indicator, bottom border, and dividers based on current state.
